'''Dyadworms''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of two-headed [[Worm/Legends|worms]] that could be [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once sold a barrel of dyadworms to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] for ninety-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
